source_correspondence: D0 retains the full complex normalized weak equation, legal energy domains, actual graph trace and inhomogeneous Robin term.
D1 proves a uniformly positive matrix square root by an absolutely convergent ordered series and every required symbol derivative.

D2 tensors one scalar nonpositive block form with one positive matrix. The full-symbol Garding estimate is uniform in epsilon; legal matrix testing retains all complex lower coefficients and the Robin source.
D3 cancels Ra and Za entry by entry in the actual operator array, retains incoming and boundary terms, and obtains the uniform mixed half-order estimate through the two earlier independent rows.
D4 expands the full Robin form with correct matrix order, retains its homogeneous order-one part, and controls only the lower defect by the exact graph trace.
D5 proves the uniform order-lowering Robin commutator for every real weight; its defect survives the smoothing limit in general.
D6 proves the exact conjugation error, normalized symbol ratios, all differentiated uniform order-zero remainders and the purely imaginary scalar leading term.

D7 proves actual H2 weighted inputs in both domains and retains every cutoff term in their equation. It gives uniform lower/defect bounds and the exact limits, without asserting a uniform global L2 source bound.

Three complete solutions and one reproducible three-panel figure illustrate the positive matrix weight, the failure of general matrix polynomial-to-block inference and the regularizer transition. Six finite groups check 67 cases.

Homogeneous Robin boundary control, incoming bounds, localized source-pairing estimates, b-energy identification and full strict propagation remain open; the current estimate keeps those actual terms.
